messages.text: Nuno on West Ham's bright start and being back in the Championship

metadata.content: Nuno Espirito Santo interview: West Ham boss on their bright start, being back in the Championship and facing QPR | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Exclusive Nuno Espirito Santo interview: West Ham boss on their bright start, being back in the Championship and facing QPR West Ham boss Nuno Espirito Santo speaks to Sky Sports about their bright start to the season and being back in the Championship. Watch West Ham vs QPR live on Sky Sports Football from 7.30pm on Friday night; kick-off 8pm. Simeon Gholam EFL Editor @simeongholam Friday 9 October 2026 06:30, UK Image: West Ham have won three of their last four in the Championship under Nuno Espirito Santo "Life changes as you get older." A reflective Nuno Espirito Santo, as he looks back on how he has changed as a manager and a person since he was last in charge of a Championship club with Wolves eight years ago. "There are a lot of things that have changed, the league has got harder. There is more quality. But some things stay the same. We still need hard work, honesty." It was the win against Wolves at the start of September that kickstarted West Ham's season. They had failed to win in their first three games in August, before a 4-2 victory over Nuno's old club at the London Stadium got things moving. From there, it was three more wins and a draw before the international break, which saw him collect the Sky Bet Championship Manager of the Month award for September. messages.text: 'It wasn't good enough' - Hamilton reveals 'huge' talks over Ferrari blunder

metadata.summary: Lewis Hamilton has revealed Ferrari held a "huge discussion" to reflect on a strategic error at the Bahrain Grand Prix that he says "wasn't good enough".
metadata.content: Lewis Hamilton: Ferrari driver says team held 'huge discussions' over strategy following Bahrain GP tyre-choice blunder | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Exclusive Lewis Hamilton: Ferrari driver says team held 'huge discussions' over strategy following Bahrain GP tyre-choice blunder Lewis Hamilton plummeted from second on the grid after starting last weekend's Bahrain GP on slick dry tyres in wet conditions; watch Practice at 9.30am followed by Sprint Qualifying at 1.30pm on Friday live on Sky Sports F1 as the Singapore Grand Prix weekend begins Thursday 8 October 2026 15:06, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Following criticisms at the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia, Lewis Hamilton defends Ferrari strategists Lewis Hamilton has revealed Ferrari held a "huge discussion" to reflect on a strategic error at the Bahrain Grand Prix that he says "wasn't good enough". Ferrari fitted both Hamilton and his team-mate Charles Leclerc with slick dry tyres at last weekend's Bahrain Grand Prix, which was being hosted in Malaysia and started on a wet track that the Italian squad anticipated would quickly dry out once the race began. The decision was proven wrong as Hamilton fell from his starting position of second to almost the back of the field in the opening stages, with the 14 of 22 drivers that started on the intermediate tyre gaining a huge advantage.
